title: L3Harris Demonstrates Integrated Mission Networking During Army Exercise
summary: L3Harris Technologies has successfully demonstrated the ability to rapidly sense threats, communicate across the joint force and orchestrate a response during the U.S. Army’s Lightning Surge series of exercises.
body_markdown:
**MELBOURNE, Fla., Aug. 27, 2026** — L3Harris Technologies (NYSE: LHX) has successfully demonstrated the ability to rapidly sense threats, communicate across the joint force and orchestrate a response during the U.S. Army’s Lightning Surge series of exercises.


L3Harris’ communications solutions enabled soldiers to expeditiously collect, share and act on critical battlefield information across dispersed formations.


“Today’s battlefield demands more than reliable communications - it requires the ability to transform information into actionable decisions at the speed of relevance,” said Chris Aebli, President, Communications & Spectrum Dominance, L3Harris. “These Lightning Surge exercises demonstrate how L3Harris is delivering integrated capabilities that help commanders see the battlefield as it is and will be in multi-domain operations.”


L3Harris is making continued progress in support of new distributed and data-driven Army requirements since the service[selected the company as an NGC2 transport layer provider](https://www.l3harris.com/newsroom/press-release/2025/10/us-army-selects-l3harris-support-ngc2-program) . These systems, including the new[Wraith Shield™ software enhancement](https://www.l3harris.com/newsroom/editorial/2026/05/wraith-shield-advantage-transforming-l3harris-radios-ai-enabled-counter) , are capable of adapting to rapidly changing operational conditions.
